name: Connecticut

officialList.label: Connecticut Secretary of the State: 2026 General Election Guide, Appendix II: 2026 Statewide Candidates (PDF)
officialList._check: The candidate list is Appendix II of the Secretary of the State's 2026 General Election Guide (PDF), which lists every general election candidate by office and district. Names and party tags are as printed there. The appendix is not dated, so a candidate who withdrew after it was printed would still show. Town sample ballots are used only to cross-check; the Secretary of the State's index of them was updated 10/15/2026 and links 108 of 169 towns.

sampleBallot.label: Find your town's sample ballot (Secretary of the State)

senateNotUp: All 36 Connecticut State Senate seats are on the ballot in 2026, so every district has a State Senate race.
houseNotOnBallot: No candidates are listed for this district in the Secretary of the State's guide. See your town's sample ballot on the Secretary of the State's site.
otherRacesNote: Your ballot may also list Judge of Probate, Registrar of Voters, and local questions (for example, a town charter change). These change by town, so check your town's sample ballot. Connecticut has no county government, so there are no county races.
senateNote: All 36 State Senate seats are up in 2026. Senators serve 2-year terms.
